Alex — thanks for the patience. Please find our consolidated responses and evidence attached: Redwood_AH_Assurance_Final.pdf, NIST_mapping.csv, Redwood_eval_plan.md. Key summary below for quick review.

Executive summary (TL;DR):
- NIST AI RMF: we map Redwood platform and operational controls to the five Outcomes; our NIST mapping (attached CSV) includes control owner, evidence artifact, and frequency of review.
- EU AI Act positioning: because AlphaHealth’s use case is healthcare-facing, the workload meets the EU definition of a high-risk AI system in the regulated context. Redwood provides a suite of mandatory mitigations (data minimization, access controls, logging, documentation, human oversight hooks) and optional deployment patterns (Private VPC, on-prem package) to support an EU-compliant operating model. We do not sign-off on regulatory classification on behalf of customers, but provide the technical artifacts needed for your compliance team.
- Evaluation & regression approach: 3-layer plan: (1) real-time lightweight monitors (latency, error-rate, token anomalies, input distribution drift), (2) weekly targeted regression tests against seeded prompt sets with automated metrics (accuracy proxies, hallucination heuristics, response length consistency), (3) quarterly human-reviewed model quality audits with sampling and annotation. Canary rollouts, automatic fallback to pinned model versions, and automatic KV-prefix caching invalidation are built into the runtime for safe rollouts.
- Evidence & controls: SOC 2 Type II report (link below), KMS/HSM integrations (customer-managed keys supported), audit logs (tokenized request traces retained per retention SLA), and product-level rollback/runbook examples included in the eval plan.

Attachments: Redwood_AH_Assurance_Final.pdf (complete questionnaire answers), NIST_mapping.csv (control -> NIST outcome mapping), Redwood_eval_plan.md (runbooks + sampling templates).

Related links and artifacts: 
- SOC 2 Type II report: https://redwood.com/security/soc2-type2
- Shared drive with artifacts: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/alphahealth/risk-questionnaire
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/ALPHA-2026-RFP-37
